verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official, open-source CLI, abctl, but its documented scope is creating and managing local Docker-based Airbyte instances. Nothing shows the CLI managing connections or syncs, or serving AI-native agent workflows. PyAirbyte, Terraform and the API are separate interfaces, not the CLI, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: CLI coverage of pipeline/connection/sync operations, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive scripting), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.
